title: A linear map that is bijective at every maximal ideal is bijective
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $\varphi:M\to N$ a homomorphism of $A$-modules. For a maximal ideal $\mathfrak m\subset A$ let $\varphi_{\mathfrak m}:M_{\mathfrak m}\to N_{\mathfrak m}$, $x/s\mapsto\varphi(x)/s$, be the localization of $\varphi$ at the multiplicative subset $A\setminus\mathfrak m$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. If $\varphi_{\mathfrak m}$ is bijective for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ of $A$, then $\varphi$ is bijective.
